items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: That's the school I went to!

ctx.x: And we used to meet on our intermissions and hang out together on 52nd Street, and Gene Krupa was beginning to play those drum solos, and Cab Calloway heard Gene Krupa play, and he wanted a drum soloist. Well, poor Maxey had never encountered that -- playing drum solos; he was a great show drummer for the shows, but he didn't know nothing about doing solos, and that's when Cab was looking for somebody that could do a Gene Krupa number.
And that's how Cozy came in.
